q: What is the carbon footprint of a bottle of perfume?
title: Perfume carbon footprint per bottle
short: The glass bottle, cap and box often weigh more than the liquid and can carry most of the footprint. Ethanol and fragrance oils follow. Blending and filling use little energy. Weigh the packaging and ask suppliers for figures per kg.

ol: Weigh bottle, pump, cap and box.
Multiply each by a supplier or secondary factor per kg.
Add ethanol and fragrance oil by volume.

p: CO2 from ethanol made from crops and released in use is biogenic and reported separately.

senseible: Senseible reads your electricity bills, fuel invoices and purchase invoices into dated, fingerprinted records, so a per unit footprint can be traced back to the documents behind it. Estimates are labelled as estimates.
